art_direction: 窄弧眼下缘轻提但不闭眼，双瞳向右，留白像一笔宽挑。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Make two narrow curved openings with lower outer edges lifted a little, suggesting amusement while remaining open. Both heavy pupils shift right. A broad upward-flick paper reserve cuts into each pupil, with uneven width and a blunt end. Use the marker's broad face for upper masses and its edge for brief lower strokes. Flat iris accents appear toward the left. Let the two arches differ slightly in tension rather than in size. Keep only these eyes on open paper, no brows or mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
